steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.skips: When a note goes from a line to the next line up or down, or from a space to the next space, it skips the note in between: that’s a third, like do to mi. The further apart two notes are on the staff, the bigger the leap: with do on a line, sol is two lines up. You sang these leaps in Unit 5; now read them. Before each skip, hear the next note in your head.
steps.triad: Do, mi, sol: from line to line (or space to space). Hear do first, then read and sing. The music waits at each note.
steps.stepsAndSkips: Steps and skips mixed, without do, re, mi under the notes. Look at each move first: the next line or space is a step, one further is a skip.
steps.inTime: Now in time, with the metronome: hear do, and after a bar counted in, keep going and read ahead. The music doesn’t wait.
